description: Security policy taken from kupecloud/github-workflows renovate/default.json at fa2920f22d9c44f8d76b8c994d3e7b861a31d396, because that repo is private and a public repo cannot extend a preset hosted there (Renovate: Cannot find preset's package). This is a deliberate security subset of that preset (vulnerability alerts, minimum release age, digest pinning, no automerge), not a full copy: its grouping, labelling, schedule and custom-manager rules are left out. Review it when the preset changes.
